title: Super Ring Mod
description: Super Ring Mod adds a powerful magical ring with incredible abilities for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. Hold the Super Ring to gain Strength V, Resistance V, Regeneration V, Speed II, and Fire Resistance.
body: Super Ring Mod is a powerful fantasy-themed Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that introduces a magical artifact known as the Super Ring. Crafted using rare and valuable materials, this legendary ring grants incredible abilities to any player strong enough to wield it. Simply holding the Super Ring in your main hand or offhand instantly gives you Strength V, Resistance V, Regeneration V, Speed II, and Fire Resistance, making survival and combat far more exciting and intense
